title: Why I Refuse to Debate Christianity

top_liked.author: @brooklynloutheskeptic
top_liked.text: Great video. I debate anyone who wants to engage but surely it hardly ever changes peoples BELIEFS anyway. Beliefs are far more about emotional attachments then evidence or logic.

top_liked.author: @donnadarko99
top_liked.text: Whoa, I needed to hear someone say that me avoiding debating xtians is not me being weak. No, I'm just tired. Thanks Darante. I'm so glad that I found you through The Line a year ago.

top_liked.author: @thelondonatheist8689

I can agree a  lot.  Sometimes  I  use the  line;
